items.title: Show HN: Fancanon – A modern fanfiction platform built with SvelteKit
items.contentSnippet:
I built (yes me a human, not vibe coded) Fancanon, a modern web app for reading and writing fanfiction.
I wanted a modern, distraction-free reading experience, so that I don't have to rely on the reading mode of the browser every time I wanted to read a chapter. From there on I collected various other pain points and tried to address them while adding some QOL features.
It took me a year to get to this point, still a long way to go. Looking for feedback and ideas to promote this.

items.title: Show HN: A calendar of every Chinese holiday your supplier will cite as a delay
items.contentSnippet:
If you've ever ordered anything from a factory in China, you've been given a delivery date of "after Chinese New Year." This is a site built around that.
What it does:
- Live status: is your supplier on holiday right now, based on China time and the official PRC holiday schedule.

items.title: Our Rooms Are Full of Collective Intelligence. We Need Collective Measurement.
items.contentSnippet: What does it mean to be educated if our transcripts cannot capture the student who made every group around them smarter? In this new piece, Jane Shore challenges the foundational assumption of traditional assessment, that learning lives inside individual heads, and invites education leaders to imagine what becomes possible when we measure contribution, collective growth, and ripples of impact alongside academic knowledge. This is essential reading for anyone rethinking what counts, and for whom.
